name: Cable Single-Leg Calf Raise
steps: Stand beside a low pulley with its handle in one hand and balance on the foot on that side.
Press through the ball of your standing foot and lift your heel.
Lower your heel to the floor with control.
Switch sides and repeat the movement.
tips: Touch the machine lightly with your free hand for balance.
Keep your standing knee straight and push evenly through the ball of your foot.
